blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)允许社会科学家对视频进行规模分析,但研究人员必须决定视频的哪些部分作为输入提供. 我们使用表达有效性这一术语来审查文本、音频、视频和综合投入如何影响衡量和随后的分析。 我们比较了6个开放重量的MLLM和3个人类附加说明的视频数据集的输入表示. 没有代表的表现一贯最好。 在7个与新闻有关的构件中,各模型(macro-F1=.70-.77)的本地-视频性能差异不大,而提取的文本性能则从.52到.80不等. 三个模型在文本上表现较好,三个则在视频上表现较好. 综合投入很少能改善业绩。 更准确的分类也无法可靠地得出更接近基于人类代码的估计数。 在42个比较中的17个比较中,最高的F1代表最能复制人类编码的回归系数. 即使每个模型使用其最高的F1可部署代表,45%的样本流行率估计数与人编码基准不同,超过10个百分点。 因此,输入表示法要求验证所测量的构造和由此产生的标签估计的数量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Before a large language model can code a video, researchers must decide how to present it. They can supply a speech transcript, add optical character recognition (OCR) of on-screen text, sample frames and attach audio, use the model’s video pathway, upload the original file, or ask the model to describe the clip and then code that description. These choices determine which information the model can use to measure the construct of interest.
blocks.zh: 在大型语言模型可以编码视频之前,研究人员必须决定如何呈现视频. 他们可以提供语音记录,添加屏幕文本的光学字符识别(OCR),样本框和附加音频,使用模型的视频路径,上传原始文件,或者请模型描述剪辑,然后编码该描述. 这些选择决定了模型可用于衡量利息结构的信息。

blocks.en: So far, input representation has received less attention than model and prompt selection. LLM annotation is now common in computational social science. Zero-shot models can match crowd workers and, on some tasks, trained experts ( Gilardi et al., 2023 ; Törnberg, 2023 ; Heseltine and Clemm von Hohenberg, 2024 ) . They work across languages and constructs ( Rathje et al., 2024 ) , and open-weight models allow researchers to run versioned annotation pipelines locally ( Alizadeh et al., 2025 ) . Their labels support claims about political communication, engagement, and elite behavior ( Marks et al., 2025 ; Solovev et al., 2026 ; Törnberg and Chueri, 2025 ) . Validation studies to date have focused on which models, prompts, and decoding settings produce agreement with human coders ( Ziems et al., 2024 ; Abraham et al., 2025 ) . For text annotation, the input often closely resembles the document researchers want to classify. Video requires additional decisions about which channels to retain and how to encode them.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,与模型相比,投入表述得到的关注较少,而且得到了及时的选择。 LLM注释目前在计算社会科学中很常见. 零射线模型可以匹配人群工人,在一些任务上,可以匹配训练有素的专家(Gilardi等人,2023年;Törnberg,2023年;Heseltine和Clemm von Hohenberg,2024年). 它们跨越语言和构造(Rathje等人,2024年),开放重量模型允许研究人员在当地运行版本的注解管道(Alizadeh等人,2025年)。 他们的标签支持关于政治沟通,参与和精英行为的说法(Marks等人,2025年;Solovev等人,2026年;Törnberg和Chueri,2025年). 迄今进行的验证研究侧重于哪些模型、提示和解码环境与人类编码者达成协议(Ziems等人,2024年;Abraham等人,2025年)。 对于文本注释,输入往往与文档研究者想要分类的类似. 视频需要更多关于保留哪些频道以及如何编码的决定.

blocks.en: A thirty-second TikTok news video may convey meaning through speech, on-screen headlines, footage, editing, music, or delivery. A transcript retains the words but discards the picture and most properties of delivery. OCR recovers written content but not music or visual context. A sparse frame sample may capture the setting while missing a brief end card. A model’s native video pathway can preserve temporal structure, although frame sampling and audio alignment vary by architecture. The value of each input depends on whether it preserves information relevant to the construct.
blocks.zh: 第三十二段TikTok新闻视频可通过演讲、屏幕头条、镜头、编辑、音乐或传送传达意义。 记录片保留了文字,但丢弃了图片和大部分交付属性. OCR恢复了书面内容,但不恢复音乐或视觉上下文. 一个稀疏的帧样本可能会捕捉到设置,同时缺少一个简短的尾卡. 一个模型的原生视频路径可以保留时间结构,尽管帧采样和音频对齐因架构而异. 每个输入值取决于它是否保存了与构造相关的信息.

blocks.en: We use representation validity to describe this part of the measurement process within established approaches to construct validity. We examine whether the representation retains the information a construct requires, whether the model uses that information, whether it combines complementary signals, and whether the resulting variable preserves the quantity researchers want to estimate.
blocks.zh: 我们利用表示有效性来描述在既定方法内建立有效性的衡量过程的这一部分。 我们研究说明是否保留了构建所需的信息,模型是否使用该信息,它是否结合了互补信号,以及由此产生的变量是否保留了研究人员想要估计的数量。

blocks.en: We examine these questions using six open-weight audio-visual LLMs and three datasets with human reference labels. We use 603 German-language TikTok news videos with codes for news values, platform features, and audiovisual properties ( Mayer et al., 2025 ) ; 400 English-language videos with codes for hate and for whether they target Black or Jewish people ( Das et al., 2023 ) ; and 650 English sitcom clips with sarcasm labels ( Castro et al., 2019 ) . We give each model the same codebook instructions while varying the input representation. Across the datasets, we compare nine input routes: metadata only, an automatic transcript, extracted speech and on-screen text, a human transcript where available, sampled frames with audio, native video, full video, combined text and video, and a model-written description. We remove audio to test whether models use sound, and we compare errors across routes to test whether models combine complementary text and video signals. We then re-estimate engagement regressions and sample prevalences to assess how coding accuracy relates to downstream estimates. Finally, we repeat runs to check computational stability.
blocks.zh: 我们利用6个开放量的视听LLM和3个带有人类参考标签的数据集来审查这些问题。 我们使用603个德语TikTok新闻视频,其中包含新闻价值、平台特征和视听属性的代码(Mayer等人,2025年);400个英语视频,其中包含仇恨和针对黑人或犹太人的代码(Das等人,2023年);以及650个带有讽刺标签的英语Sitcom剪辑(Castro等人,2019年)。 我们给每个模型 同样的密码本指示 同时改变输入的表示。 在整个数据集中,我们比较了9条输入路线:仅元数据、自动记录稿、提取的语音文本和屏幕文本、现有的人文记录稿、带音频、原生视频、完整视频、合并文本和视频的样本框架以及模型书写描述。 我们删除音频来测试模型是否使用声音,我们比较跨路线的错误来测试模型是否结合了互补的文本和视频信号. 然后,我们重新评估参与回归和抽样流行率,以评估编码准确度与下游估计数的关系。 最后,我们重复运行 检查计算稳定性。

blocks.en: On the seven verbally defined news constructs, native-video macro-F1 ranges from .70 to .77 across models, compared with .52 to .80 for extracted text. Three models perform better with extracted text and three with native video. The wider comparison also shows that representation effects vary by model and construct. Comparing constructs on the same videos helps separate these effects from differences between datasets: audiovisual input improves coding of visual setup more consistently than coding of verbal news constructs, and its advantage differs between the two HateMM target-group variables.
blocks.zh: 在7个口头定义的新闻构造上,本地-视频宏F1在模型上从0.70到.77不等,而提取的文本则从.52到.80不等. 三个模型使用提取的文本表现较好,三个则使用本土视频. 更广泛的比较还表明,表现效果因模型和构造而异。 比较同一视频上的构造有助于将这些效果与数据集之间的差异区分开来:视听输入比口头新闻构造的编码更一致地改进了视觉设置的编码,其优势在两个HateMM目标组变量之间也有所不同.

blocks.en: The audio ablations show that models use sound differently across tasks. Removing audio can substantially reduce performance on hate or sarcasm while barely affecting another task. Both Gemma models can transcribe English speech with an appropriate prompt, yet rarely identify music. Text and audiovisual routes also make complementary errors, but providing both in one call usually yields little improvement over the better individual route.
blocks.zh: 音频调制显示,模型对不同任务使用不同的声音. 清除音频可以大大减少仇恨或讽刺的性能,而几乎不影响另一项任务。 两个Gemma模型都可以用适当的即时音译英语语音,但很少识别音乐. 文本和视听线路也产生补充性错误,但用一个电话提供这两个线路通常不会比更好的个别线路有任何改进。

blocks.en: Higher macro-F1 does not reliably identify the representation that best recovers a downstream estimate. In the news application, the highest-F1 route produces the smallest regression-coefficient error in 17 of 42 model–construct comparisons. Across all three datasets, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates remain more than ten percentage points from the human-coded reference even after selecting the highest-F1 deployable route. These results support validating model–representation combinations for the intended construct and for the estimates calculated from their labels.
blocks.zh: 较高的宏观F1无法可靠地确定最能恢复下游估计数的表示。 在新闻应用中,最高的F1路线在42个模型–构建比较中的17个中产生最小的回归系数错误. 在所有三个数据集中,即使选择了最高的F1可部署路线,45%的抽样流行率估计数仍然比人编码参考值高出10个百分点以上。 这些结果支持验证模型 -- -- 拟建构件和从其标签中计算的估计数的表示值组合。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM annotation in computational social science
blocks.zh: 2.1 计算社会科学中的LLM注释

blocks.en: Automated content analysis is a measurement problem: an instrument should agree with a trusted reference and support valid substantive inference ( Grimmer and Stewart, 2013 ; Song et al., 2020 ; Baden et al., 2022 ) . Generative LLMs have made this work less costly. Zero-shot annotation with ChatGPT outperformed crowd workers on several political-text tasks ( Gilardi et al., 2023 ) , matched or exceeded experts on political tweets ( Törnberg, 2023 ) , and approached expert coders across political-science annotation tasks ( Heseltine and Clemm von Hohenberg, 2024 ) . Similar results hold for sentiment, discrete emotions, and offensiveness across twelve languages ( Rathje et al., 2024 ) , although performance varies across computational social science tasks and constructs ( Ziems et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动内容分析是一个测量问题:一项仪器应当与可靠的参考一致,并支持有效的实质性推论(Grimmer and Stewart,2013年;Song等人,2020年;Baden等人,2022年)。 遗传 法学硕士使这项工作的成本降低。 与ChatGPT的零镜头注释在几个政治文字任务上表现优于群众工人(Gilardi等人, 2023年), 虽然计算社会科学任务和构造的表现各不相同(Ziems等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Subsequent work has examined how to produce and validate these annotations. Open-weight models permit local processing and reproduction from archived weights, but researchers must report model settings and fine-tuning choices that affect performance ( Alizadeh et al., 2025 ; Ollion et al., 2024 ) . Small changes in prompt wording can also shift accuracy ( Abraham et al., 2025 ) . Validation must extend beyond classification: even accurate labels can bias downstream regressions, and methods such as design-based supervised learning use human-coded subsamples to correct that bias ( TeBlunthuis et al., 2024 ; Egami et al., 2023 ) . Operational choices affect costs as well; annotating multiple items and variables per call can reduce costs with little loss of accuracy ( Pipal et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 随后的工作审查了如何编写和验证这些说明。 开放重量模型允许从存档重量进行本地处理和复制,但研究人员必须报告影响性能的模型设置和微调选择(Alizadeh等人,2025年;Ollion等人,2024年)。 迅速措辞的小改动也可改变准确性(Abraham等人,2025年)。 验证必须超越分类:即使准确的标签也可能偏向下游回归,基于设计的监督学习等方法使用人码子样本来纠正这种偏差(TeBlunthuis等人,2024年;Egami等人,2023年). 操作选择也影响成本;每次调用多项目和变量的注释可以减少成本,很少丧失准确性(Pipal等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Substantive studies increasingly use LLM-generated codes as measures. GPT-4o codes of ingroup solidarity and outgroup hostility in Facebook posts show how engagement shifted after the political crises of the 2024 US campaign ( Marks et al., 2025 ) ; LLM measures of incivility and character attacks link hostile campaign rhetoric to electoral outcomes ( Banks and Stone, 2026 ) ; LLM-coded tweets of parliamentarians in 26 countries trace a rise in elite incivility ( Törnberg and Chueri, 2025 ) ; and language-model estimates track outgroup animosity among politicians, journalists, and partisan users over a decade ( Fulay and Roy, 2026 ) . Similar designs measure framing in news articles ( Tohidi et al., 2025 ) and mobilization in protest communication ( Eckardt et al., 2025 ) . Increasingly, the material is audiovisual. A study of 25,292 TikTok videos by German politicians uses GPT-4-turbo to code automatic video transcripts for outgroup animosity, identity language, and relatability ( Solovev et al., 2026 ) . Multimodal models now also code who appears in candidates’ Instagram stories ( Achmann-Denkler et al., 2026 ) . These studies depend on the representation supplied to the model, although they rarely compare alternative representations.
blocks.zh: 实质性研究越来越多地使用LLM生成的代码作为衡量标准. GPT-4关于群体团结和群体外敌对的代码在脸书文章中显示, 2024年美国竞选政治危机后, 在新闻报道(Tohidi等人,2025年)和动员抗议宣传(Eckardt等人,2025年)中设定类似的设计措施。 这些材料越来越多地是视听材料。 德国政治人物对25,292个TikTok视频的研究使用GPT-4涡轮码自动录制视频记录片,用于群体外的敌意,身份语言,以及相对性(Solovev等人,2026年). 多式联运模式也出现在候选者中 Instagram storys (Achmann-Denkler et al., 2026). 维基百科中的相关条目: 维基语录链接:名人名言 - 文学作品 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 这些研究取决于提供给模型的代表性,尽管它们很少比较替代的代表性。

blocks.en: Model and prompt selection thus have established roles in annotation validation. For multimodal data, researchers must also decide how to represent the material before the model processes it.
blocks.zh: 因此,模型和即时选择在注释验证方面发挥了既定作用。 对于多式联运数据,研究人员还必须决定在模型处理之前如何代表材料。

blocks.en: 2.2 From text annotation to multimodal social data
blocks.zh: 2.2 从文本注释到多式联运社会数据

blocks.en: Research that codes audiovisual political material has historically combined speech recognition for what is said, computer vision for faces, objects, and settings, and human coding or supervised classifiers on top ( Joo and Steinert-Threlkeld, 2022 ; Boussalis et al., 2021 ) . A validation of automated coding for campaign advertisements shows that such component pipelines reach human-level reliability for many but not all variables ( Tarr et al., 2023 ) . Which channel carries a construct matters. When human coders rate parliamentary speeches from transcripts and from video, the valence of a speech carries over to the transcript, whereas its emotional arousal does not ( Cochrane et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 对视听政治材料进行编码的研究,将语音识别、面部、物体和背景的计算机视觉以及上层的人类编码或受监督的分类方法(Joo and Steinet-Threlkeld, 2022年;Boussalis等人, 2021年)。 对竞选广告自动编码的验证表明,这种组件管道对于许多但并非所有变量都达到人的水平可靠性(Tarr等人,2023年)。 哪个频道有构造问题 当人类编译者从文字记录和录像中评分议会演讲时,演讲的优雅就随笔录而来,而其情绪激动则不然(Cochrane等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Multimodal LLMs can process several channels in one call, but their performance varies across settings. Open and proprietary multimodal models approach human reliability when rating emotional arousal in laboratory recordings but fall well short on real parliamentary debates ( Licht, 2026 ) . Benchmarks for video LLMs show that models can answer many items without the visual channel and that accuracy does not necessarily reflect use of that channel ( Lee, 2026 ) . Video LLMs also read on-screen text poorly ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , which matters for platforms on which much of a video’s verbal content appears as overlaid text. Converting video into text first can sometimes improve performance. For example, describing clips and reasoning over the descriptions outperforms end-to-end video models on long-video question answering ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 多式联运LLMS可以在一次呼叫中处理几个频道,但其性能因设置而异. 公开和专有的多式联运模式在实验室录音中评价情绪激动时,会接近人类的可靠性,但在真正的议会辩论中却远远不够(Licht,2026年)。 视频 LLMS 的基准显示,模型可以在没有视觉频道的情况下回答许多项目,准确性并不一定反映该频道的使用(Lee, 2026). Video LLMS在屏幕上读得也不好(Shi等人,2025年), 先将视频转换为文本有时可以提高性能. 例如,在长视频问题回答上描述片段和对描述的推理超越了端到端的视频模型(张等人,2024年).

blocks.en: This work shows that constructs rely on different channels, models vary in their ability to extract them, and intermediate text representations can perform well. It leaves open how alternative representations compare when researchers hold the videos, social-science constructs, model, and prompt constant.

blocks.zh: 2.3 作为衡量决定的代表性

blocks.en: Representation sufficiency concerns R R . A representation is sufficient for a construct if it retains the information that the construct definition requires. A transcript cannot be sufficient for music detection, and sixteen sampled frames may miss a brief on-screen prompt. Researchers can assess sufficiency from each construct’s codebook definition before running a model (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: Inferential validity concerns estimates calculated from Y ^ \hat{Y} . Automated labels can agree closely with human codes yet yield different regression coefficients, because the effect of a coding error depends on where it occurs in the data ( TeBlunthuis et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 推论有效性涉及从Y^\hat{Y}中计算出的估计数. 自动标签可以与人类代码紧密一致,但产生不同的回归系数,因为编码错误的影响取决于数据中发生的地点(TeBlunthuis等人,2024年).

blocks.en: We use these four checks to define our research questions. RQ1 asks how much annotation validity changes when we present the same videos through different representations. RQ2 asks whether representation effects depend on the information requirements of the target construct. RQ3 asks whether multimodal models use the modalities we provide and whether they can integrate complementary signals. RQ4 asks whether representation-induced measurement differences alter downstream substantive conclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们用这四个检查来确定我们的研究问题。 RQ1询问当我们通过不同的表达方式呈现相同的视频时,注释的有效性会有多少变化. RQ2询问表示效果是否取决于目标构造的信息要求. RQ3询问多式联运模式是否使用我们提供的方式,以及它们是否能够融合互补信号. RQ4询问代表引起的测量差异是否改变下游的实质性结论。

blocks.en: 3 Data and research design
blocks.zh: 3 数据和研究设计

blocks.en: In our experiments, we hold the model, codebook prompt, decoding settings, and evaluation target constant while varying how we represent each item (Figure 1 ). In addition, we provide the same item metadata with every route.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们保持模型,代码本的快速,解码设置,以及评价目标常数不变,同时我们如何代表每个项目(图1). 此外,我们提供与每个路线相同的项目元数据。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Representation as part of measurement. We apply a representation procedure R R to the original object X X , producing the input X R X_{R} that the model observes. We then use the model’s codes Y ^ \hat{Y} in substantive analysis. Our four validation checks address different steps of this process.
blocks.zh: 图1:作为衡量工作的一部分的代表性。 我们对原对象X X 应用了表示程序R R,产生模型观察到的输入X R QQR}. 然后我们用模型的代码 Y ^\ hat{Y}进行实质性分析。 我们的四项验证检查涉及这一进程的不同步骤。

blocks.en: 3.1 Validation datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 验证数据集

blocks.en: We use three datasets with human reference labels (Table 1 ). They differ in language, domain, and the channels relevant to their constructs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个带有人类参考标签的数据集(表1)。 它们的语言、域和与其构造有关的渠道各不相同。

blocks.en: We use News on TikTok as our primary dataset. It contains videos that German-language news outlets in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland posted on TikTok in 2023. Trained coders annotated the videos using a published codebook ( Mayer et al., 2025 ) . We draw a class-quota sample of 603 test videos from the 7,978 videos that the published release classifies as news. We sample until each class of four verbally defined constructs (geographic scope, negative news, conflict, and scope) contains about 200 videos. Within each class, we weight candidates by their country’s share of the corpus and count each selected video toward every class it matches. We exclude 132 development videos that we drew earlier using the same procedure and used only for format checks. The test draw yields 612 videos, but we could not download nine of them and did not replace them (Appendix 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把TikTok新闻作为我们的主要数据集。 它包含了德国,奥地利和瑞士的德语新闻机构于2023年在TikTok上发布的视频. 训练有素的编码员使用已出版的编码本(Mayer等人,2025年)对录像进行注释。 我们从公布的7,978个视频中抽取了603个测试视频样本,这些视频被归类为新闻。 直到每类四个口头定义的构造(地理范围、负面新闻、冲突和范围)都包含约200个视频。 在每一班中,我们用考生在他们国家中所占的份额来衡量考生,并按每一班选取的录像进行计算。 我们排除了我们先前使用同样程序绘制的132个发展视频,这些视频只用于格式检查。 试画产生612个视频,但我们无法下载其中9个视频,也没有替换(附录6 ).

blocks.en: This procedure over-represents minority classes of the four quota constructs. For example, the human coders identify conflict in 33% of test videos, compared with 14% of the corpus. The other constructs remain close to their corpus shares. We use the sample to evaluate classification and to compare automated and human-coded sample prevalences; we do not estimate prevalence in the corpus or on the platform. Professional news videos often repeat information across voice-over, on-screen headlines, and footage, making them a useful setting for testing how much video adds beyond extracted text.
blocks.zh: 这一程序过多地代表了四个配额结构中的少数群体类别。 例如,人体编码员在33%的测试视频中识别出冲突,而其中14%的测试视频显示冲突。 其他建筑仍然接近其保费份额。 我们利用样本来评估分类,并比较自动化和人类编码的样本流行情况;我们不估计该体或平台上的流行情况。 专业新闻视频经常在翻唱、屏幕头条和镜头中重复信息,成为测试视频在摘录的文本之外增加多少内容的有益环境。

blocks.en: We use 400 videos from HateMM , a dataset of BitChute videos with human hate-speech annotations ( Das et al., 2023 ) : 200 hateful and 200 non-hateful videos. We include hateful videos only if the annotated hateful segment starts within the first 120 seconds, so that every route includes material from the relevant segment. These user-generated videos can convey hate through speech, symbols, imagery, or a combination of channels. The original annotators also recorded which community each video targets or concerns, for hateful and non-hateful videos alike. We analyze two of these target-group labels as separate constructs: whether a video targets Black people (207 of 400 videos) and whether it targets Jewish people (47 of 400). Comparing three constructs on the same videos lets us test whether representation effects differ by construct while holding the material constant.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自HateMM的400个视频, 这是BitChute的视频的数据集, 我们只包含仇恨的视频,只要附加注释的仇恨片段在前120秒内开始,这样每一条路线都包含来自相关片段的材料. 这些由用户制作的视频可以通过语音,符号,图像,或综合频道来传达仇恨. 最初的注目者也记录了每个视频针对或关注的社群, 我们分析其中两个目标组标签作为单独的构件:是否一个视频目标 黑人(400个视频中的207个)以及是否针对犹太人(400个视频中的47个). 比较同一视频上的三个构件,让我们可以测试在保持材料恒定的同时,表现效果是否因构造而异。

blocks.en: We use 650 clips from MUStARD , a dataset of English-language sitcom utterances with audio and human sarcasm labels ( Castro et al., 2019 ) . We reserve 40 of the original 690 clips for development (20 per class), leaving 650 test clips, of which 325 are sarcastic. We include the preceding dialogue that the dataset provides as context. Sarcasm may depend on delivery as well as on words and context. We also use MUStARD’s human transcripts to distinguish automatic speech-recognition errors from differences between representations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自MUSTARD的650个片段,这是一套带有音频和人语讽刺标签的英语喜剧言论数据集(Castro等人,2019年). 我们保留了原有的690个剪辑中的40个用于开发(每班20个),剩下650个测试剪辑,其中325个是讽刺性的. 我们列入了数据集作为上下文提供的上述对话。 讽刺可能取决于交付以及语言和背景。 我们还使用MUSTARD的人文笔录来区分自动语音识别错误与陈述之间的差异.

blocks.en: Table 1: Validation datasets.
blocks.zh: 表1:验证数据集.

blocks.en: 3.2 Constructs and their information requirements
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑及其资料要求

blocks.en: We use the coding definitions to classify channels as required, potentially informative, or unnecessary for each construct (Table 2 ). This table is a descriptive classification assembled during interpretation of the results; it is not an independently validated measure of channel requirements. We then check whether representation effects match those information requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们使用编码定义按要求对通道进行分类,可能提供信息,或对每个构造都没有必要(表2)。 本表是在解释结果时汇总的描述性分类;它不是对信道要求的一种独立有效的衡量。 然后我们检查说明效果是否与信息要求相符。

blocks.en: The seven news constructs that we call verbally defined are those whose definitions refer to what a story is about or to prompts that can be spoken or written. We include geographic scope, negative news, conflict, scope, two kinds of calls to interact, and other people’s voice. We select these constructs because they occur often enough in the sample and their definitions refer mainly to verbal content. We examine purely visual and auditory constructs separately. Two of the seven verbally defined constructs also involve nonverbal information. A call to interact on TikTok can be “purely visual or via an animation,” and whether “the voice of people other than the journalist” is heard depends on who speaks, which a transcript does not record. The two audiovisual anchors , visual set-up and music, require visual or auditory evidence and serve as manipulation checks: providing the relevant channel should improve performance.
blocks.zh: 我们称之为口头定义的七种新闻结构是那些其定义是指一个故事的内容或可以讲或写成的提示。 我们包括地理范围、负面新闻、冲突、范围、互动的两种呼声,以及其他人的声音。 我们选择这些构造是因为它们经常出现在样本中,它们的定义主要指口头内容. 我们分别审查纯粹的视觉和听力结构。 7个口头定义的构件中有两个还涉及非口头信息。 在TikTok上互动的呼声可以“纯粹是视觉的,也可以是动画的,是否听到“记者以外的人的声音”取决于谁说话,而录音记录不录。 两个视听主播(视觉设置和音乐)需要视觉或听觉证据,并作为操纵检查:提供相关频道应改善性能。

blocks.en: Table 2: Information requirements by construct, classified from the coding definitions. ⚫ required; ❍ potentially informative; – not required. “Audio” refers to non-verbal sound and to properties of the voice (who speaks, tone), as distinct from the words spoken.
blocks.zh: 表2:按构件分列的信息需求,从编码定义中分类。 需要; 可能的信息; – 不需要。 " Audio " 是指非口头声音和语音的属性(谁说话,语气),不同于所讲的词.

blocks.en: On-screen text
blocks.zh: 屏幕文本

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en: We use six open-weight LLMs that accept both images and audio and return text. They are Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 E4B ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Qwen3-Omni 30B-A3B ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , Qwen2.5-Omni 7B ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , Nemotron-3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , and MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( Yao et al., 2024 ) . The set includes dense and mixture-of-experts architectures with different approaches to audio processing. We require audio input so that every model can receive speech audio in the frames + audio route. We exclude models without audio input (for example Gemma 4 26B and 31B) because they cannot run that route as defined. We list exact checkpoints and revisions in Appendix 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用6个开放量的LLM,既接受图像,也接受音频和返回文本. 它们是Gemma 4 12B和Gemma 4 E4B(Google DeepMind,2026年),Qune3-Omni 30B-A3B(徐等人,2025年b),Qune2.5-Omni 7B(徐等人,2025年a),Nemotron-3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B(NVIDIA,2026年),以及MiniCPM-o 4.5(姚等人,2024年). 该套包括密集和混合的专家结构,对音频处理有不同的方法. 我们需要音频输入,以便每个模型都能在帧+音频路径中接收语音音频. 我们排除没有音频输入的模型(例如Gemma 4 26B和31B),因为它们不能按定义运行这条路由. 我们在附录7中列出了确切的检查站和修订。

blocks.en: We use the six models to assess whether representation effects recur across architectures, sizes, and developers. Our focus is on these effects and their variation across models, rather than on a model ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们用这六个模型来评估在结构、规模和开发者之间是否重复出现代表效应。 我们的重点是这些影响及其不同模型的差异,而不是模型排名。

blocks.en: We run all models on one NVIDIA A100 (80 GB) with vLLM 0.30 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , using bfloat16 precision and greedy decoding. We disable reasoning (“thinking”) modes and use a JSON-schema grammar to restrict outputs to each construct’s legal codes. Completed coding calls return parseable, in-scale answers; this does not prevent input-processing failures. We code the nine news constructs together and the two HateMM target variables together. Hate and sarcasm each use a separate single-construct call. We disable prefix caching and the multimodal preprocessing cache, except that the capped full-video runs use the preprocessing cache (Appendix 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们运行所有模型在一个NVIDIA A100(80 GB)上,使用vLLM 0.30(Kwon等人,2023年),使用bfloat16精度和贪婪的解码. 我们禁用推理(“思考”)模式,使用JSON-schema语法将输出限制在每种构造的法典中。 已完成的编码调用返回可解析, 比例化的答案; 这无法防止输入处理失败 。 我们把九个新闻结构 和两个HateMM目标变量一起编码 仇恨和讽刺各自使用单独的单构调用. 我们禁用前缀缓存和多式联运预处理缓存,只是封装的全视频运行使用预处理缓存(附录7 ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Representation routes
blocks.zh: 3.4 代表路线

blocks.en: We compare the nine routes in Table 3 , using each model to code every item through every route that its dataset supports. We provide at most the first 120 seconds of each video, except in the full-video route, where we supply the original file. We also provide the same metadata across routes: outlet and nationality, caption, and hashtags for news; show, speaker, and preceding dialogue as a human transcript for sarcasm. HateMM provides no metadata. We use the same prompt across routes within each corpus, changing only one sentence to describe the input material (Appendix 18 ). The news and hate prompts use definitions from the source coding guidelines; for sarcasm and the HateMM target variables, we supply operational definitions consistent with the source annotations. We fix each prompt before running its corresponding comparison and retain it across models and routes. The original news, hate, and sarcasm prompts were frozen before the first test-set calls; the target-group prompts and additional video routes were introduced later. We use the development sets for format and input-processing checks, not accuracy tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们比较表3中的九条路线, 用每个模型来编码每一个项目 通过其数据集支持的每一个路线。 我们最多提供每段视频的前120秒,除了全视频路线,我们提供原始文件. 我们还提供相同的元数据,包括出口和国籍、标题和新闻标签;展示、演讲和对话,作为讽刺的人类记录。 HateMM没有提供元数据. 我们使用每本书中相同的横跨路线的提示,只更改一个句子来描述输入材料(附录18 ). 新闻和仇恨提示使用来源编码准则中的定义;对于讽刺和HateMM目标变量,我们提供与来源说明一致的操作定义. 在进行相应的比较之前,我们先固定每个提示,然后在模型和路线上保留它。 最初的新闻,仇恨,讽刺的提示在第一次试播集通话之前就被冻结了;后来引入了目标组提示和额外的视频通道. 我们使用开发组进行格式和输入处理检查,而不是精确调试。

blocks.en: Table 3: Representation routes. ASR: automatic speech recognition (Whisper large-v3-turbo). OCR: optical character recognition at one frame per second, near-duplicate lines removed. The three video routes differ in who decides which pictures the model sees and in how pictures and sound are packaged.
blocks.zh: 表3:代表路线。 ASR:自动语音识别(Whisper big-v3-turbo). OCR:光学字符识别,每秒一个帧,近似重复线被移除. 三种视频路线在由谁决定模型所看到的图片以及图片和声音的包装方式上有所不同.

blocks.en: The video routes differ in sampling and encoding. For frames + audio , we supply sixteen still images and separate audio clips. The model encodes each image independently, without explicit alignment to the sound. This input is identical across models and also supplies the video component of text + video.
blocks.zh: 视频路线在采样和编码上有所不同. 对于帧+音频,我们提供16个静态图像和单独的音频片段. 模型将每个图像独立编码,不与声音明确对齐. 这种输入在各种模型中是相同的,还提供了文本+视频的视频部分.

blocks.en: For native video , we supply a file containing the first 120 seconds at 448 pixels. Each model’s video pathway samples sixteen frames and encodes them as a sequence. Some models encode these frames more compactly than independent images; two align the audio with the frames. This route keeps the visual budget approximately constant while allowing architecture-specific processing.
blocks.zh: 对于本地视频,我们提供的文件 包含头120秒 在448像素。 每个模型的视频路径对16帧进行取样,并将其编码为序列。 一些模型比独立图像更简洁地编码这些帧;两个模型使音频与帧一致. 这个路由使视觉预算保持了大约不变,同时允许特定架构的处理.

blocks.en: For full video , we supply the original file and use the model’s default frame sampling and resolution. Long or high-resolution files may exceed context or memory limits. We also test a capped version with 32 frames from the full file and audio clips from the first 120 seconds. We retain a full-video cell only if at least 95% of items are processed. All retained cells use the untouched original; no capped fallback rescued an otherwise excluded cell. Appendix 10 reports completion counts, including the 20-video capped-news pilots for the two Qwen models.
blocks.zh: 我们提供原始文件, 长或高分辨率文件可能超过上下文或内存限制. 我们还测试一个封装版本,其中32帧来自完整文件,音频片段来自前120秒. 只有至少95%的物品得到处理,我们才保留一个全视频单元。 所有保留细胞都使用未激活的原始;没有封盖的倒置救出一个原本被排除的细胞. 附录10报告了完成计数,包括两个Quen模型的20视频封顶新闻试点.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate each construct against the human reference labels using macro-F1, the unweighted mean of F1 across the codebook’s categories. We exclude missing or unclear ( − 99 -99 ) human labels separately for each construct. Among the remaining items, we count missing or invalid model outputs as incorrect, including failures caused by inputs that exceed a model’s limits. To summarize a group of constructs, we average their macro-F1 scores rather than pooling their items. We also report nominal Krippendorff’s α \alpha against the human labels ( Hayes and Krippendorff, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们用宏-F1来对照人类参考标签来评估每个构造, 我们不包括每个构件的缺失或不明(−99-99)人类标签。 在其余项目中,我们把缺失或无效的模型产出算作不正确,包括超出模型限度的投入造成的失败。 总结一下一组构造,我们平均它们的宏-F1分数,而不是集合它们的项目. 我们还报告Krippendorff名义上的αα与人类标签(Hayes和Krippendorff,2007年)。

blocks.en: We report macro-F1 for every route, construct, and model, with 95% confidence intervals from an item bootstrap (1,000 resamples). We compare routes within each model and construct, using the same items. For each model and construct we identify the observed best route and compare every other route with it through the paired bootstrap distribution of the difference in macro-F1. Using a margin of ± .05 \pm.05 macro-F1, we call a route practically equivalent to the best if the 90% interval of the difference lies within ± .05 \pm.05 , worse if the interval lies entirely below − .05 -.05 , and inconclusive otherwise. Because we select the comparator for having the highest observed score, the comparison favors it. We therefore treat this as a descriptive diagnostic rather than a confirmatory equivalence test. We also report margins of .03 and .10 as sensitivity checks.
blocks.zh: 我们报告每个路径、构造和模型的宏-F1, 95%的置信间隔来自一个靴子(1,000个复标) 。 我们比较每个模型的路线,并利用相同的物品进行构造。 对于每个模型和构造,我们确定观测到的最佳路线,并通过宏-F1差异的配对靴子分布来比较所有其他路线。 使用 ± 05\pm.05 宏- F1 的比值,如果差值的90%在 ± 05\pm.05 以内,我们称为实际上等于最佳的路线,如果间隔完全在 ± 05 - 05 以内,则更糟糕的是,如果间隔完全在 − . 05 - 05 以内,否则就无定论。 因为我们选择比较者 拥有最高的观察分数, 比较有利于它。 因此,我们将此视为一种描述性诊断,而不是一种确认等同性测试。 我们还报告03和10的差值为敏感性检查。

blocks.en: We summarize the loss from choosing a route as its shortfall , the distance in macro-F1 between that route and the best route of the same row. We decompose the variation of construct-level macro-F1 across models, routes, and constructs into main effects and interactions; with one value per cell, this is an exact descriptive decomposition, not a test. Where we compare two specific routes, we report the paired bootstrap difference (2,000 resamples, same items for both routes) with its 95% interval. We do not test differences across the six models, which are not independent observations.
blocks.zh: 我们总结了选择一条路线作为它的不足而造成的损失,即这条路线与同一行的最佳路线之间的宏观-F1距离。 我们把构造级宏F1的变异分解为模型,路线,构筑成主效应和相互作用;每个细胞有一个值,这是精确的描述分解,而不是测试. 在比较两条具体路线时,我们报告配对的靴子差值(两千个复标,两条路线的相同项目)与95%的间隔。 我们不测试六个模型之间的差异,这六个模型不是独立的观察。

blocks.en: We test audio use by coding the same visual input with and without its audio track. We run this audio ablation on a random subsample of 150 news videos, where we also vary the number of frames, on all 400 HateMM videos, and on all 650 sarcasm clips. We run additional diagnostic tests for the two Gemma models because their initial news results show little response to audio. We test an audio-only route, the media placement recommended in the Gemma 4 documentation (images before the instruction, audio after it), a direct question about music, and transcription with the developer’s recommended prompt. We also repeat the tests with a second inference backend, Hugging Face transformers.
blocks.zh: 我们测试音频用法,将相同的视觉输入编码,无论是否其音频音轨。 我们在150个新闻视频的随机子样本上 播放了这个音频衰减, 在其中,我们也改变帧数, 在所有的400 HateMM视频上, 在所有的650个讽刺片段上。 我们为两个Gemma模型进行了额外的诊断测试, 因为他们的初步新闻结果对音频反应不大。 在Gemma 4文档中推荐的媒体定位(在指令前, 我们还用第二个推论后端,即牵引面部变压器重复测试.

blocks.en: To assess integration , we classify each model’s item × \times construct decisions into four cases: both routes are correct, only extracted text is correct, only frames + audio is correct, or both are wrong. We then calculate an oracle score by selecting the correct label whenever either route provides it and the extracted-text label when both routes are wrong. This diagnostic uses the human reference labels to show the benefit of resolving disagreements correctly; we cannot use it to code unlabeled data.
blocks.zh: 为了评估整合情况, 我们把每个模型的项目 \\ times 构建决定为四个案例: 两种路线正确, 只有提取的文本正确, 只有帧 + 音频正确, 或者两者都错误 。 然后,我们通过选择正确的标签来计算甲骨文分数,只要任一路由提供它,如果两个路由都是错误的,则选择提取的文本标签。 这种诊断用人类的参考标签来正确显示解决分歧的好处;我们不能用它来编码未加标签的数据.

blocks.en: To assess inferential validity , we re-estimate an engagement regression on the news data, replacing the human codes with each route’s codes (Section 4.5 ). For each coefficient, we examine whether pipelines with higher macro-F1 produce estimates closer to the human-code estimate. We also check whether selecting the highest-F1 route selects the route with the smallest coefficient error. For every binary construct across the three datasets, we compare automated and human-coded sample prevalences, both across all routes and after selecting each model’s highest-F1 route.
blocks.zh: 为了评估推断的有效性,我们重新评估新闻数据的接触回归,用每条路线的代码取代人类代码(第4.5节)。 对于每个系数,我们研究宏观-F1高的管道是否产生更接近人文代码估计的估计数. 我们还检查选择最高的-F1路由是否选择最小系数错误的路由. 对于跨越三个数据集的每一个二进制构造,我们比较了自动化和人码样本的流行程度,无论是在所有路线上,还是在选择了每个模型的最高F1路线后.

blocks.en: We assess reproducibility by re-running 50 news videos on six routes with identical settings.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在6条路线上重播50个设置相同的新闻视频来评估可转载性。

blocks.en: An initial analysis plan, the original codebook prompts, and the inference code were frozen on 10 September 2026, with their SHA-256 hashes recorded locally; the plan was not deposited in a public registry. After interim results, we moved from laptop inference to the A100 and reran the study, expanded the model set, and added the native- and full-video routes and HateMM target-group comparisons. The broader grid, integration, prevalence, and downstream route-selection analyses developed during this extension. We therefore report these comparisons as descriptive and exploratory, while retaining the initial plan’s ± .05 \pm.05 equivalence margin. Appendix 7 gives further details. We used generative AI in preparing replication material and supplementary information, as specified in the declarations.
blocks.zh: 最初的分析计划,原始的代码表提示,推断代码于2026年9月10日被冻结,他们的SHA-256散列记录在当地;计划没有存入公共登记册. 临时结果后,我们从笔记本推导到A100并重新调整研究,扩展模型集,并增加了本土-全视频路线和HateMM目标组比较. 扩大网格、集成、普及和下游路线选择分析是在延长期间进行的。 因此,我们报告这些比较是描述性的和探索性的,同时保留最初计划的±.05\pm.05等值比值。 附录7提供了进一步的细节。 我们使用基因AI编写复制材料和补充资料,如申报所述。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Completed calls on extracted text, frames + audio, and native video produced no unparseable or out-of-codebook answers. Native-video processing nevertheless failed on 12 of 400 HateMM videos for Qwen2.5-Omni and on 3 for Nemotron, in both the hate and target-group calls; these failures count as incorrect. Extracted text and frames + audio completed on all test items. Figure 2 shows macro-F1 for every route, construct, and model on all three datasets. We summarize scores by construct group in Appendix Table 8 and provide all cell values and intervals in the replication package.
blocks.zh: 已完成对已提取文本、帧+音频的调用,以及本地视频没有产生无法解析或代码外的解答。 然而,在Qwen2.5-Omni的400个HateMM视频中,有12个视频和Nemotron的3个视频在仇恨和目标群体的呼声中都未能处理好;这些失败算不上是不正确的。 在所有测试项目上完成提取的文本和帧+音频. 图2显示所有三个数据集上每个路由,构造和模型的宏-F1. 我们在附录表8中按构造组汇总分数,并提供复制包中的所有单元格值和间隔。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Macro-F1 for every route, construct, and model. Rows: the nine news constructs (verbal constructs above the first white line, the two audiovisual anchors below), hate, the two HateMM target groups, and sarcasm. Orange frame: observed best route in the row. Bold: best or practically equivalent to it (90% interval of the paired difference within ± .05 \pm.05 ). n/a: the original-file route failed the 95% completion threshold and no tested capped fallback met it. Empty: route not defined for the dataset (no metadata for HateMM; human transcripts only for sarcasm). For sarcasm, extracted text equals the transcript.
blocks.zh: 图2:每个路线、构造和模型的宏-F1。 排行:九新闻构筑(第一白线上方的口头构造,下面的两个视听主播),仇恨,两个HateMM目标群体,以及讽刺. 橙色框架:列中观测到的最佳路线. 粗体:最优或实际等值(在±.05\pm.05范围内的配对差间隔为90%). n/a:原始文件路由未达到95%的完成阈值,没有经过测试的封顶倒置满足. 空:没有为数据集定义的路由(HateMM没有元数据;人文笔录只用于讽刺). 对于讽刺,提取的文字等于抄本.

blocks.en: 4.1 Representation sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.1 代表敏感性

blocks.en: For news, we compare representations on the same videos and constructs with constant prompts and models. On the seven verbally defined constructs, native-video macro-F1 falls in a narrow range from .70 to .77 across all six models. Extracted-text performance spans .52 to .80. The direction of the difference therefore reverses across models. Gemma 4 12B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Qwen3-Omni perform better from extracted text, whereas Qwen2.5-Omni, Nemotron, and MiniCPM-o perform better from native video. The paired native-video minus extracted-text differences range from − .06 -.06 to + .18 +.18 , with all intervals excluding zero (Appendix 9 ).
blocks.zh: 与不断的提示和模型进行对比。 在7个口头定义的构造上,所有6种模型的原生-视频宏F1的坠落范围从0.70到.77不等。 摘录文本的性能从.52到.80. 因此,这种差异的方向在模型中颠倒。 Gemma 4 12B,Gemma 4 E4B,和Qune3-Omni从提取的文本中表现较好,而Qune2.5-Omni,Nemotron,和MiniCPM-o则从本地视频中表现较好. 成对的本地-视频减去提取的文本差异范围从−.06-.06到+18+18,所有间隔均不包括0(附录9 ).

blocks.en: This variation also appears across the full grid. Across the 78 model–construct combinations, no route dominates (Figure 2 ). Extracted text is the observed best route in 16 combinations, native video in 15, frames + audio in 14, text + video and describe first in 10 each, full video in 7, metadata only in 4, and the transcript in 2. Relative to the observed best route, 24% of the 510 pairwise comparisons are practically equivalent within the pre-specified ± .05 \pm.05 margin, 37% are worse by more than .05, and 38% remain inconclusive (Figure 3 a; Appendix Table 8 ). The typical shortfall is small for several routes. The median is .02 for text + video and .03–.04 for the main text and video routes. Every route nevertheless has combinations on which its shortfall is substantial. The size of the best-or-equivalent set changes with the margin; many comparisons remain inconclusive.
blocks.zh: 这一变化也出现在整个网格中。 横跨78型 — 构造组合,无路线主导(图2 ). 摘录的文本是16个组合中观测到的最佳路线,15个是本土视频,14个是帧+音频,14个是文本+视频,并分别以10个分别描述,7个是完整视频,4个是元数据,2个是笔录. 相对于观察到的最佳路线,510对比比中,24%在预先规定的±0.05\pm.05比值内实际上相当,37%比0.05差,38%仍未确定(图3a;附录表8)。 典型的缺口在几条路线上很小. 中位数为文本+视频的0.02,主要文本和视频线路的0.03–04. 然而,每一条路线都有其缺口巨大的组合。 最优或等值的大小与比值的设定变化;许多比较仍无定论.

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) Shortfall of each route from the observed best route of the same model and construct (78 combinations; full video 54, metadata only 60). Orange: best or practically equivalent (90% interval of the paired difference within ± .05 \pm.05 ); light orange: inconclusive; grey: worse by more than .05. Numbers below: share of combinations in which the route is best, and in which it is best or practically equivalent. (b) Decomposition of the variation in construct-level macro-F1 across six models, six routes available for all constructs (transcript, extracted text, frames + audio, native video, text + video, describe first), and 13 constructs.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 每条路线与观察到的同一模型的最佳路线的不足和构造(78个组合;全视频54,元数据只有60个)。 橙色:最佳或实际等效(在±05\pm.05范围内的配对差间隔为90%);浅橙色:无定论;灰色:比0.05以上差. 以下数字: 组合中最优路线,最优路线或实际等同路线的比例. (b) 解析6种模型的构造一级宏F1的变异、所有构造可用的6条路线(图文、提取的文字、帧+音频、原生录像、文字+视频、第一描述)和13条构造。

blocks.en: The variance decomposition shows that representation effects depend on the model and construct (Figure 3 b). Differences between constructs account for 51% of the observed variation in macro-F1. The route main effect accounts for 4% and the model main effect for 5%, while route × \times construct accounts for 10%, model × \times route for 5%, model × \times construct for 16%, and the three-way interaction for another 10%. Most variation associated with representation occurs through its interactions with the construct and model.
blocks.zh: 差异分解表明,表示效应取决于模型和构造(图3b)。 在宏观-F1中观测到的变异中,不同构造的差异占了51%. 路由主效应占4%,模型主效应占5%,而路由×\times构造占10%,模型×\times路由占5%,模型×\times构造占16%,三向互动占另外10%. 与代表性有关的大多数变化是通过它与构象和模型的相互作用发生的。

blocks.en: The ordering of routes also varies in HateMM and MUStARD. For hate, extracted text (.76 to .83) or text + video (.76 to .85) is the observed best route for four of six models, and no video route improves on extracted text by more than .02. For sarcasm, the preferred route changes sharply across models. The Gemma models do best from the transcript or text + video, Qwen3-Omni from the full clip, Qwen2.5-Omni from text + video, and Nemotron and MiniCPM-o from a model-written description. When models can process the untouched file, its pooled performance stays within .04 of native video. Providing the original file offers no consistent advantage over the reduced representations.
blocks.zh: HateMM和MUSTARD的路线顺序也各不相同。 对于仇恨,提取文本(.76至.83)或文本+视频(.76至.85)是6个模型中4个模型观测到的最佳路径,任何视频路径对提取文本的改进都不超过02. 对于讽刺来说,首选的路线在各种模型之间发生了剧烈的变化. Gemma模型在抄本或文本+视频中表现最好,在完整剪辑中的Quen3-Omni,在文本+视频中的Quen2.5-Omni,在模型写作的描述中Nemotron和MiniCPM-o. 当模型可以处理未触及的文件时,其集合性能会停留在原生视频的0.04范围内. 提供原始档案与减少的陈述相比没有一贯的优势。

blocks.en: 4.2 Construct dependence
blocks.zh: 4.2 构造依赖性

blocks.en: We compare constructs on the same items to hold language, genre, sample, and annotation source constant. On the 603 news videos, frames + audio improves on extracted text by .36 macro-F1 on average for visual setup, with the interval above zero in all six models. For other people’s voice, the mean gain is .12 and five of six intervals lie above zero. By contrast, the six remaining verbal constructs range from a mean difference of − .02 -.02 to + .08 +.08 , with models disagreeing in sign (Appendix 9 ). For music, the audiovisual advantage varies with the model’s use of audio. Relative to the verbal-construct mean, the additional gain for music ranges from − .02 -.02 to + .45 +.45 with frames + audio and is positive with a confidence interval above zero for five of six models under native video.
blocks.zh: 我们比较同一物品上的构造,以保持语言、流派、样本和注释源常数。 在603个新闻视频上,帧+音频在提取的文本上得到改进,平均通过36个宏-F1进行视觉设置,所有6个模型的间隔均高于0. 对其他人来说,平均收益是12,6个间隔中有5个高于零。 相比之下,其余6个口头构造从-.02-.02到+.08+.08不等,模型在符号上有分歧(附录9 ). 对于音乐来说,视听优势随模型对音频的使用而不同. 相对于口头构造的意指,音乐的额外收益范围从−.02-.02到+45+.45加上帧+音频,在本地视频下6个型号的5个置信间隔超过0是正数.

blocks.en: We make a second same-item comparison using HateMM. On the same 400 videos, all six models code the Black-target variable best from extracted text or text + video, while five of six code the Jewish-target variable best from a video route (Figure 2 ). Frames + audio gains more over extracted text for the Jewish-target variable than for the Black-target variable in every model; the difference is .04 to .12 in five models, with the paired interval above zero in four. Thus, the preferred representation can change with the target construct even when we hold the videos and models constant.
blocks.zh: 我们用HateMM做第二个同题比较 在同一400个视频上,所有六个模型都从提取的文本或文本+视频中编码了最佳的黑-目标变量,而六个代码中的五个则从视频路径(图2)中编码了最佳的犹太-目标变量. 框架+音频增益大于每个模型中犹太-目标变量的提取文本;差异为5个模型的0.04至12,对位间隔大于0的4个. 因此,更受欢迎的表达方式可以随着目标构建而改变,即使我们保持视频和模型不变.

blocks.en: The wider comparison follows a similar pattern. Video performs best for visual setup in every model and for music in the four models that use its audio signal. Results for the verbal news constructs vary by model. We interpret cross-dataset contrasts cautiously because language, genre, construct, and annotation source vary together. The same-item comparisons provide clearer evidence that representation effects depend on both the information a construct requires and the model’s ability to use it.
blocks.zh: 比较范围较广的情况也类似。 视频在每一个模型中表现得最好,在使用其音频信号的四个模型中表现得最好。 口头新闻结构的结果因模式而异。 由于语言,流派,构造,以及注释来源各有不同,所以我们对跨数据集的对比是谨慎的. 同一项目比较提供了更明确的证据,表明表示效果取决于一个构造所需的信息以及模型使用这种信息的能力。

blocks.en: 4.3 Modality utilization
blocks.zh: 4.3 模式利用

blocks.en: We test models’ use of audio by removing it from the frames + audio route while keeping the visual input constant (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们测试模型对音频的使用,方法是从帧+音频路径中删除音频,同时保持视觉输入常数(图4).

blocks.en: Figure 4: Audio ablation: macro-F1 of the frames + audio input with and without the audio track. News: random subsample of 150 videos (seven verbal constructs pooled; music). Hate: 400 videos (not run for the two target groups). Sarcasm: 650 clips. Numbers give the change when the audio is removed.
blocks.zh: 图4 音频衰减:框架的宏-F1 + 音频输入有和无音频音轨. 新闻:随机抽查150个视频(7个口头构造集合;音乐). 仇恨:400个视频(不为两个目标群体运行). 讽刺:650夹. 数字在删除音频时给出变化 。

blocks.en: The effect of removing audio varies by task. For hate, removing the soundtrack lowers macro-F1 in every model by .10 to .21. For sarcasm, it costs Gemma 4 12B .08, Gemma 4 E4B .16, and Qwen2.5-Omni .07. Music detection drops by .17 to .46 in the four non-Gemma models. Yet on the seven verbal news constructs, removing audio changes the two Gemma models by .01 or less, while it costs Nemotron .07 and MiniCPM-o .05. These differences show why researchers need to assess audio use for each task.
blocks.zh: 删除音频的效果因任务而异. 对于仇恨,去除音轨将每个模型中的宏-F1降低0.10到0.21. 对于讽刺,它花费了Gemma 4 12B.08,Gemma 4 E4B 16,以及Quen2.5-Omni 07. 音乐检测在四个非Gemma模型中以17比46下降. 然而在7个口头新闻构造上,移除音频会以0.01或更低的速度改变两个Gemma模型,而Nemotron.07和MiniCPM-o.05则花费了成本. 这些差异表明研究人员为什么需要评估每项任务的音频使用.

blocks.en: Further tests distinguish speech transcription from music detection in the Gemma models (Table 4 ). Both Gemma models transcribe English speech well when we use the developer-recommended transcription instruction. Their median word error rate is .11 on the sitcom clips. An earlier generic prompt had made Gemma 4 12B appear unable to transcribe many clips, so that result was a prompting artifact. Media placement affects the audio-only news task. For Gemma 4 12B, coding the news constructs from audio alone rises from .69 when audio precedes the instruction to .76 when it follows it, as the documentation recommends; once frames are present, the change is only .01. Neither Gemma model reliably detects music. When we ask directly whether an audio clip contains music, the Gemma models answer yes for only 0–2% of the first 30-second audio clips. The human labels identify music in 72% of the corresponding whole videos, but we do not have separate reference labels for these short clips. This difference in observation windows limits the direct prevalence comparison. We find the same pattern when we repeat the probe with Hugging Face transformers, making a vLLM-specific explanation unlikely. The models can process speech, but this ability does not extend reliably to music detection in these tests.
blocks.zh: 进一步的测试区分了Gemma模型中的语音转录和音乐检测(表4). 两个Gemma模型在使用开发者推荐的转录指令时,将英语的语音音译得非常好. 他们的中位词误差率在喜剧片段为0.11. 早先的通用提示使Gemma 4 12B似乎无法翻录许多剪辑,因此结果是一件提示性文物. 媒体定位会影响只有音频的新闻任务. 对Gemma 4 12B来说,将新闻构造从音频单独编码从指令前的.69上升至指令之后的.76,如文件建议的那样;一旦帧出现,变化只有0.01。 Gemma模型都无法可靠地检测到音乐. 当我们直接问一个音频片段是否包含音乐时,Gemma模型只回答对头30秒音频片段的0–2%. 人类的标签在相应的整个视频的72%中识别音乐,但我们对这些短片没有单独的参考标签. 观测窗口的这种差异限制了直接的流行率比较. 我们发现同样的模式 当我们重复探测器 与哈格格面部变压器, 使得一个VLLM 特定的解释是不可能的。 这些模型可以处理语音,但这种能力无法在这些测试中可靠地延伸到音乐检测.

blocks.en: Table 4: Gemma audio diagnosis on 150 news videos, with Nemotron as control. Placement “after the instruction” follows the Gemma 4 documentation (images before the text, audio after it); our main runs placed all media before the text. The direct music probe uses the first 30 seconds; 72% of the corresponding whole videos, not necessarily these clips, have a positive human music label.
blocks.zh: 表4:Gemma在150个新闻视频上的音频诊断,以Nemotron为控制. 在Gemma 4文件(文本前的图像,文本后的音频)之后放置“在指令之后”;我们的主要运行将所有媒体置于文本之前。 直接音乐探测器使用前30秒;72%的对应整个视频,不一定是这些片段,都有正面的人类音乐标签.

blocks.en: All six models transcribe the English sitcom clips well with their recommended prompts (median word error rates .05 to .11). Against the Whisper reference on the German news clips they are substantially weaker (.37 to .77), which helps explain why a dedicated speech-recognition pipeline can be competitive for the German verbal constructs. Frame count matters much less in this application. Relative to 16 frames, 32 changes pooled news macro-F1 by at most .01, while reducing the input to four frames costs up to .04 (Appendix Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 所有六个模型都用推荐的提示(中间字误差率.05至.11)将英文的Sitcom剪辑记录得很好。 与德国新闻短片中的Whisper语句相对, 框架计算在本应用程序中的重要性要小得多。 相对于16帧,32位将新闻集合宏F1最多改为0.01位,同时将输入量减少到4帧成本,最高可达0.04位(附录表10 ).

blocks.en: 4.4 Multimodal integration
blocks.zh: 4.4 多式联运

blocks.en: Extracted text and audiovisual input make complementary errors. Across every model and construct group, some decisions are correct only from extracted text and others only from frames + audio (Appendix Table 12 ). Depending on the model and dataset, 1–24% of decisions are correct only from text and 3–47% only from video. A diagnostic oracle that takes the correct answer whenever either route has it would improve on the better single route by .01 to .16 macro-F1, with a median gain of .07 (Figure 5 ). The two sets of predictions thus contain correct labels that neither route consistently recovers alone.
blocks.zh: 摘录的文本和视听投入产生补充性错误。 在所有模型和构造组中,有些决定只从提取的文本中正确,另一些决定只从帧+音频中正确(附录表12 )。 根据模型和数据集,1–24%的决定只有文本正确,3–47%的决定只有视频正确. 只要任何一条路线都有正确的答案,就能够通过0.01到16 macro-F1改进更好的单一路线,中间增益为.07(图5)。 因此,两套预测都含有正确的标签,即两个路线都无法单独恢复。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Integration across datasets: macro-F1 of extracted text (sarcasm: transcript), frames + audio, both in one call (text + video), and an oracle that selects the correct single-route prediction whenever one is available. The oracle uses human reference labels and is a diagnostic benchmark.
blocks.zh: 图5 跨数据集整合:提取文本的宏-F1(sarcasm: text),帧+音频,两者均以一个调用(text + video)形式进行,以及一个甲骨文,在任何可用时选择正确的单程预测. 甲骨文使用人类参考标签,是诊断基准.

blocks.en: Providing both representations in one call rarely improves on the better individual route. Across the 36 model–group combinations, text + video ranges from .08 below to .03 above the better single route, with a median difference of − .003 -.003 ; it exceeds the better route by .02 or more in only 14% of cells. Its performance often closely follows one of the component routes. On the news constructs it tracks the video route even for the three models whose extracted-text route is better. Gemma 4 12B, for example, scores .80 from extracted text, .75 from frames + audio, and .75 from both. For the Black-target variable in HateMM, the combined route tracks the text route in five of six models. The combined-input results fall short of the gains suggested by the complementary predictions.
blocks.zh: 在一通电话中提供两种表述方式,很少在更好的个别路线上有所改进。 在36个模型的组合中,文本+视频从下面的0.08到上面的0.03,中间差为−003-003;在只有14%的单元格中,它超过了更好的路线。 其性能经常紧跟其中一条组成部分路线. 在新闻中,它会追踪到视频路线, 即使对于三个模型, 例如,Gemma 4 12B从提取的文本中得分为.80分,帧+音频得分为.75分,两者均得分为.75分. 对于HateMM中的黑-目标变量,合并路由会以6个模型中的5个跟踪文本路由. 综合投入结果没有达到补充预测显示的成果。

blocks.en: 4.5 Inferential consequences
blocks.zh: 4.5 后果

blocks.en: We examine whether differences in the automated labels change two quantities: engagement-regression coefficients in the news data and the prevalence of each binary construct in the validation samples.
blocks.zh: 我们审查自动标签的差异是否改变两个数量:新闻数据的接触-递归系数和验证样本中每个二进制结构的普及性。

blocks.en: We re-estimate an OLS model of log(1 + views) on the six binary focal constructs and geographic scope, with outlet fixed effects and HC1 standard errors, using the 599 news videos with complete human codes and view counts. With human codes, negative news ( β ^ = .63 \hat{\beta}=.63 , SE .29) and conflict ( β ^ = .79 \hat{\beta}=.79 , SE .30) are positively associated with views, while foreign news is negatively associated ( β ^ = − .71 \hat{\beta}=-.71 , SE .36). We then replace the human codes with each model’s codes from extracted text, frames + audio, and native video.
blocks.zh: 我们重新估计关于六个二进制焦构件和地理范围的LOLS模型(1+视图),其中输出固定效果和HC1标准错误,使用有完整的人文代码和查看计数的599个新闻视频. 用人代码,负面新闻(β ^ = .63\hat\β.63,SE.29)和冲突(β ^ = 79\β.79,SE.30)与观点有正面联系,而外国新闻则有负面联系(β ^ = → – .71\hat\β.71,SE.36). 然后我们用每个模型的代码来取代人类的代码, 取自文字、帧+音频和原生视频。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Inferential validity in the news data ( n = 599 n=599 ). (a) Coefficients from the engagement regression estimated with human codes (diamond, shaded 95% interval) and with each model’s codes from extracted text and native video. (b) For each coefficient separately, the rank correlation across pipelines between the construct’s macro-F1 and the absolute deviation of the coefficient from the human-code estimate. Filled: 18 pipelines (six models × \times extracted text, frames + audio, native video); open: 36 pipelines (all six routes used in the regression). Negative values mean that more accurate codes recover the estimate better.
blocks.zh: 图6:新闻数据中的推定有效性(n=599n=599). (a) 与人类代码(diammond, 阴影95%间隔)和从文字和原生视频中提取的每个模型代码估计的接触回归的系数。 (b) 对于每个单独的系数,建筑的宏观-F1与系数绝对偏离人文代码估计数之间的排位关系。 填充:18条输油管(6条型号×\time提取的文本,帧+音频,原生视频); 开通:36条输油管(回归时使用的所有6条路线). 负值意味着更准确的代码能更好地恢复估计值.

blocks.en: Using automated codes changes the coefficient estimates (Figure 6 a). All 18 automated negative-news coefficients are smaller than the human-code coefficient, with a mean ratio of .49. All 18 conflict coefficients are smaller as well, with a mean ratio of .20. Across all eight coefficients, sign agreement with the human-code estimate is 69% for extracted text, 73% for frames + audio, and 77% for native video (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 使用自动化代码改变系数估计(图6 a). 所有18个自动负新闻系数都小于人码系数,平均比为.49. 所有18个冲突系数都较小,平均比率为0.20。 在所有8个系数中,与人码的签名协议估计有69%用于提取文本,73%用于帧+音频,77%用于本地视频(表5)。

blocks.en: Table 5: Recovery of the human-code regression estimates by route (48 estimates per route: 8 coefficients × \times 6 models). The human estimates’ 95% intervals are wide (half-widths .55 to .71), so interval overlap is uninformative here.
blocks.zh: 表5:按路线恢复人码回归估计(每条路线估计48个:8个系数×\时6个模型). 人类估计的95%的间隔是宽的(55至71的半宽),因此间隔重叠在这里是无法解释的。

blocks.en: Selecting a route by macro-F1 does not reliably minimize coefficient error. For each coefficient, we compare the same estimate across 18 pipelines. The Spearman correlation between construct-level macro-F1 and absolute coefficient error ranges from − .52 -.52 to + .44 +.44 , with a median of − .14 -.14 (Figure 6 b; Appendix Table 17 ). For three of the eight coefficients, the correlation is positive: pipelines with higher F1 have larger coefficient errors. The model–construct comparisons show the same pattern. Among extracted text, frames + audio, and native video, the route with the highest macro-F1 is also the route with the smallest coefficient error in 17 of 42 comparisons. Uniform random choice among three routes would yield 14 in expectation. Choosing by F1 adds a median error of .08 log points, or .28 human standard errors, relative to the best route; at the 90th percentile it exceeds 1.2 standard errors. These comparisons share items, models, and routes, so we use them descriptively rather than as independent hypothesis tests.
blocks.zh: 通过宏-F1选择一个路径并不能可靠地最小化系数错误. 就每个系数而言,我们比较了18个管道的相同估计数。 构造级宏-F1和绝对系数误差之间的斯皮尔曼关系范围为−.52-52至+.44+44,中位数为−.14-14(图6b;附录表17)。 对于8个系数中的3个,相关是正数:F1较高的管道有较大的系数误差. 模型-构造比较显示相同的模式. 在提取的文本中,帧+音频,以及原生视频中,宏-F1最高的路由也是42个比较中17个最小系数误差的路由. 在三条路线中统一随机选择,预期会有14条路线。 由F1选择,相对于最佳路径,增加了0.08对数点的中位误差,即28人标准误差;在第90百分位误差超过1.2标准误差. 这些比较共享项目,模型和路线,因此我们用它们来描述而不是作为独立的假设测试.

blocks.en: We next compare, for every binary construct, the share coded positive by the automated pipeline with the reference-coded share in the same sample (Figure 7 ). Because all three validation samples are balanced or quota samples, these are not estimates of population or platform prevalence. They test whether the automated variable reproduces the prevalence of the human-coded variable on the same items. Across 496 route–model–construct estimates, 59% differ from the reference by more than 10 percentage points and 32% by more than 20. Removing metadata-only or restricting the comparison to deployable routes leaves the result essentially unchanged (Appendix Table 13 ). Even when we select each model’s highest-F1 deployable route for each construct, the median absolute error is 9 points; 45% of estimates remain more than 10 points away and 21% more than 20 points away. Selecting the most accurate labels therefore improves prevalence recovery but does not ensure it.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将每个二进制构造中自动管道编码的共享正数与同一样本(图7)中的参考码共享数进行比较。 由于所有三个验证样本都是均衡或配额样本,这些都不是人口或平台流行率的估计. 它们测试自动化变量是否复制了同一物品上人类编码变量的普及性. 跨496条路线-模型-构造估计值,59%与参考值差异超过10个百分点,32%超过20个百分点. 仅删除元数据或限制与可部署路线的比较,结果基本上保持不变(附录表13)。 即使我们为每个构造选择了每个模型中最高的F1可部署路线,中位绝对误差是9点;45%的估计数仍然在10点以上,21%在20点以上。 因此,选择最准确的标签可以改善流行程度的恢复,但不能确保恢复。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Prevalence estimated from automated codes minus the reference-coded prevalence in the sample, for every binary construct, model, and route (496 estimates). Last column: for each model and construct, the deployable route with the highest macro-F1 (66 estimates). Blue: news constructs; orange: hate, target groups, and sarcasm.
blocks.zh: 图 7:对每一二进制结构、模型和路线(496项估计数),从自动编码中减去样本中参考编码的流行率后估计的流行率。 最后一栏:对于每个模型和构造,可部署路线的宏-F1最高(66估计). 蓝色:新闻构造;橙色:仇恨,目标群体,讽刺.

blocks.en: 4.6 Robustness and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.6 强性和可复制性

blocks.en: Four of the six models could process the untouched original files across all three datasets (Nemotron failed on 4.5% of HateMM videos, mostly because the audio exceeded a size or duration limit). For both Qwen models, most news and HateMM files crashed the vision encoder (Qwen3-Omni) or exceeded the context window (Qwen2.5-Omni, 32k tokens). Capping the visual input at 32 frames did not produce a usable fallback: Qwen2.5-Omni processed 12 of 20 attempted news videos and 147 of 400 HateMM videos; Qwen3-Omni processed none of the 20 news videos and only one HateMM video. The news pilots do not establish completion rates for all 603 videos (Appendix Table 10 ). Uploading the original file is therefore infeasible for some models and datasets. Where full video ran, it performed like native video (within .04 pooled).
blocks.zh: 6个模型中有4个可以处理所有3个数据集中未触动的原始文件(Nemotron在HateMM视频的4.5%上失败,主要是因为音频超过了大小或持续时间限制). 对于Quen模型来说,大多数新闻和HateMM文件都崩溃了视觉编码器(Quen3-Omni)或者超过了上下文窗口(Quen2.5-Omni,32k令牌). 在 32 帧中抓取视觉输入没有产生可用的回落 : Quen2.5-Omni处理了20个未遂新闻视频中的12个和400个HateMM视频中的147个;Quen3-Omni处理了20个新闻视频中的任何一个,只有一个HateMM视频。 新闻飞行员没有为所有603个视频确定完成率(附录表10)。 因此,上传原始文件对于一些模型和数据集来说是不可行的. 完整视频运行的地方,它像本地视频(在04集内)一样播放.

blocks.en: The standardized frames + audio input and the model’s own video pathway give the same pooled result on the news constructs (differences within ± .012 \pm.012 ), although individual constructs can move by up to ± .15 \pm.15 ; frames at 896 instead of 448 pixels change pooled macro-F1 by at most .02 (Appendix 10 ).
blocks.zh: 标准化框架+音频输入和模型自己的视频路径对新闻构造给出了相同的集合结果(差异在±012\pm.012之内),尽管单个构造最多可移动±15\pm.15;帧为896,而不是448像素最多以0.02改变集合宏-F1(附录10)。

blocks.en: The agreement results give a less favorable assessment than the macro-F1 values, which reach .94. In Krippendorff’s α \alpha , only 12% of the 252 results from six models, six routes (metadata only, transcript, extracted text, frames + audio, text + video, describe first), and seven news constructs reach .667, and only for one construct does the best route reach the agreement of the two trained coders in the published pretest. When we treat the six models as six coders, their agreement ranges from α = .27 \alpha=.27 to .70 (Appendix 14 ).
blocks.zh: 协议结果给出的评价不如宏F1值,其数值达到.94。 在Krippendorff的α-alpha中,252条中只有12%来自6条模型、6条路线(只提供元数据、记录、提取文本、帧+音频、文本+视频、第一描述)和7条新闻构造达到667条,只有一条构造的最好路线在公布的预测试中得到了两位经过培训的编码员的同意。 当我们把这六个模型当作六个编码器处理时,它们的协议范围从α=27\alpha=27到.70(附录14)不等.

blocks.en: We re-run 50 news videos on six routes with identical settings on the same GPU. Models reproduce 97.3% to 99.8% of individual codes and all nine codes for 81% to 98% of item–route pairs (Appendix 15 ). Batched GPU inference is not fully deterministic. The least stable here were the two mixture-of-experts models (97.3% and 97.9%), with one dense model close behind (98.3%); six models do not support a conclusion about architectures, and no route was consistently less stable than the others.
blocks.zh: 我们重播了6条线路的50个新闻视频 同一GPU的设置相同 模型复制了97.3%至99.8%的单个代码和所有9个代码的81%至98%的线程对(附录15). Batched GPU推论并不完全确定. 这里最不稳定的是两种专家混合模型(97.3%和97.9%),一个密集模型紧跟在后面(98.3%);6种模型不支持关于建筑的结论,没有一条路线始终不如其他模型稳定。

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Cost

Coding from extracted text required 0.09 to 0.26 A100 GPU-seconds per news video, frames + audio 0.36 to 1.11 seconds (Appendix 16 ). At the University of Zurich computing rate of CHF 0.081 per A100-hour, coding 1,000 news videos therefore costs CHF 0.002 to 0.006 from extracted text and CHF 0.008 to 0.025 from frames + audio. At on-demand prices of commercial cloud providers, US$3.43 (Amazon Web Services) to US$3.67 (Microsoft Azure) per A100-hour ( Amazon Web Services, 2026 ; Microsoft Azure, 2026 ) , the same jobs cost US$0.09 to 0.27 and US$0.34 to 1.13. For these inference runs, the absolute cost differences between representations are small.
blocks.zh: 提取文本的编码需要0.09至0.26 A100 GPU秒每条新闻视频,帧+音频0.36至1.11秒(附录16 ). 在苏黎世大学每A100小时0.081瑞士法郎的计算率中,1 000个新闻视频的编码费用从摘录的文本中为0.002至0.006瑞士法郎,从帧+音频中为0.008至0.025瑞士法郎。 按商业云供应商的点播价格,每A100小时3.43美元(Amazon Web Services)至3.67美元(微软Azure)(Amazon Web Services, 2026;Microsoft Azure, 2026),相同的工作成本为0.09美元至0.27美元,0.34美元至1.13美元. 对于这些推论,陈述之间的绝对成本差异很小。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our study shows that input representation belongs in the specification of a video annotation instrument. Transcripts, sampled frames with audio, native video, and original files expose different information to the model. Switching between them can change the resulting variables while the model, prompt, decoding settings, and source videos remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究表明,输入表示属于视频注释器的规格。 记录片,带音频,原生视频的抽样帧,以及原始文件向模型暴露不同信息. 在它们之间的切换可以改变产生的变量,而模型,即时,解码设置,以及源视频仍然固定.

blocks.en: For the seven verbal news constructs, native-video performance is similar across models (.70–.77 macro-F1), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80 and changes their ordering. Across the full comparison, the main effect of representation is small relative to its interactions with model and construct. A representation that works well in one model–construct combination may perform poorly in another. Reporting the model name and prompt is therefore insufficient for reproducing a multimodal measure. Researchers should also document speech and OCR extraction, frame counts and resolution, audio alignment, truncation, and media placement within the prompt. Each affects the evidence the model receives.
blocks.zh: 对于7个口头新闻架构,各模型(70–77 macro-F1)的本土-视频性能相似,而提取的文本性能则从.52到.80,并改变它们的订单. 在整个比较中,代表性的主要作用与其与模型和构造的互动相比很小。 在一种模式-构筑组合中行之有效的表述方式在另一种模式中可能表现不佳。 因此,报告模式名称和及时性不足以复制多式联运措施。 研究人员还应记录语音和OCR提取、帧计数和解析、音频对齐、截断以及媒体在提示中的位置。 每一个都会影响模型收到的证据。

blocks.en: Our findings do not establish a general preference for text or video. Extracted text can outperform audiovisual input on verbal news constructs, whereas visual setup requires pictures. On the same HateMM videos, audiovisual input has different advantages for the Black-target and Jewish-target variables. The codebook helps identify relevant channels, but performance also depends on whether the model uses them. Full video adds a feasibility constraint. Where models can process the original file, performance is close to that of the controlled video routes. Two models, however, fail to process most original news and HateMM files, and the capped trials do not establish a reliable fallback. Researchers need to test whether their model can process a candidate representation reliably before scaling up annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果并没有确定普遍倾向于文本或视频。 摘录的文字可以超过口头新闻构造的视听输入,而视觉设置则需要图片. 在同一HateMM视频上,视听输入对黑-目标变量和犹太-目标变量有不同优势. 代码本帮助识别相关通道,但性能也取决于模型是否使用它们. 完整视频增加了可行性限制. 在模型可以处理原始文件的地方,性能接近受控视频路线. 然而,两种模式未能处理大多数原始新闻和HateMM文件,被封杀的试验也无法确定可靠的倒置。 研究人员需要测试他们的模型是否能够在扩大注释之前可靠地处理候选人代表。

blocks.en: An audio-capable model may use sound for one task and largely ignore it for another. The ablations show large effects for hate, smaller effects for some sarcasm models, and little effect for several models on verbal news content. Both Gemma models transcribe English speech with the recommended prompt but rarely detect music. Changing media placement mainly affects the audio-only task, and the music failure recurs with a second inference backend. These findings support testing modality use for the specific construct and input configuration. Integration also requires a separate check. The oracle gains a median .07 macro-F1 by selecting correct predictions from the two routes using the reference labels. The combined-input route exceeds the better component by at least .02 in only 14% of model–group combinations. Receiving several modalities therefore does not establish that a model combines their useful signals.
blocks.zh: 一个音效能模型可能将声音用于一个任务,而基本上忽略另一个任务. 剧情展现出对仇恨的较大影响,对一些讽刺模型的影响较小,对数个模型的口头新闻内容影响不大. 两个Gemma模型都用推荐的快速但很少检测到的音乐来翻译英语语音. 改变媒体布置主要会影响只有音频的任务,音乐故障会与第二个推论后端重现. 这些结论支持使用测试方式进行具体构建和输入配置。 一体化还需要单独检查。 甲骨文通过使用参考标签从两条路线中选择正确的预测,获得0.07宏-F1的中位数. 组合输入路由在只有14%的型号-组组合中至少比更好的组件多0.02. 因此,接受几种模式并不能确定一种模式结合了它们的有用信号。

blocks.en: The downstream analyses show why annotation validation should include the intended estimate. Automated codes substantially attenuate the negative-news and conflict coefficients, and higher macro-F1 does not consistently correspond to smaller coefficient error. Among the three main routes, selecting the highest-F1 route also selects the closest coefficient estimate in 17 of 42 model–construct comparisons. The prevalence analysis yields a similar result. Even after selecting the highest-F1 deployable route for each model and construct, 45% of estimates differ from the human-coded sample prevalence by more than ten percentage points. This is consistent with prior work on misclassification bias ( TeBlunthuis et al., 2024 ) : the effect of coding errors depends on their distribution across the data. F1 and agreement statistics remain useful assessments of a classifier, but neither alone establishes whether its labels support the intended estimate. A human-coded subset can support both forms of validation. Researchers can use it to compare representations before scaling up and to assess or correct error in downstream estimates ( Egami et al., 2023 ) . Similar checks may be useful beyond video wherever preprocessing changes the evidence available to a computational measure.
blocks.zh: 下游分析表明,为什么说明的验证应当包括预期的估计。 自动化代码大大降低了负-新闻和冲突系数,较高的宏-F1与较小的系数误差不一致。 在三个主要路线中,选择最高的-F1路线也会在42个模型-构造比较中的17个选择最接近的系数估计. 流行率分析得出类似结果。 即使在为每个模型和构造选择了最高-F1可部署路线之后,45%的估计与人类编码的样本流行率相差超过10个百分点。 这与先前关于错误分类偏差的工作(TeBlunthuis等人,2024年)是一致的:编码错误的影响取决于它们在整个数据中的分布. F1和协议统计仍然是对分类者的有益评估,但两者都不能单独确定其标签是否支持预期的估计。 一个人码子集可以支持两种形式的验证. 研究人员可以利用它来比较表述,然后扩大并评估或纠正下游估计的错误(Egami等人,2023年)。 在预处理将现有证据改变为计算措施时,类似的检查可能超出视频范围。

blocks.en: Based on our findings, we recommend five checks for multimodal LLM annotation. 1. Validate more than one plausible representation. Use a human-coded subset to compare model–representation combinations that researchers could reasonably deploy, and use a substantively defined equivalence margin rather than treating non-significance as interchangeability. 2. Match the candidate representations to the construct, then test utilization. The codebook indicates which channels could matter; a simple modality ablation shows whether the model actually uses them on the task. 3. Do not assume that additional modalities are integrated. Compare a combined route with its components. Check whether the combined input improves on the better component when the individual routes make different errors. 4. Validate the downstream quantity when automated labels feed substantive inference. Classification accuracy and estimand recovery need not select the same pipeline. Where possible, use the human-coded subset to quantify or correct the resulting measurement error. 5. Archive the representation as part of the instrument. Record extraction tools, frame and audio handling, prompt placement, model checkpoints, outputs, and a re-run check. The representation and the realized model outputs are part of what must be reproducible. These checks should include model-specific input conventions and processing limits. For the inference runs measured here, GPU cost differences are small enough to give priority to validation among feasible routes.
blocks.zh: 根据我们的调查结果,我们建议对多式联运LLM注释进行五项检查。 1. 验证不止一项可信的陈述。 使用人类编码的子集来比较模型 - 代表组合,研究者可以合理部署,并使用实质性定义的等值比值,而不是将非显式视为可互换性. 2. 将候选人的表述与施工结果相匹配,然后测试利用率。 代码本显示哪些频道可能很重要;一个简单的模式衰减显示该模型是否在任务中实际使用它们. 3. 不要假定其他模式是一体化的。 比较结合路线及其组件. 检查组合输入是否在单个路径发生不同错误时对更好的组件有所改进. 4. 在自动标签输入实质性推论时验证下游数量。 分类准确性和刺激性回收不需要选择同样的管道。 在可能的情况下,使用人码子集来量化或纠正由此产生的测量错误. 5. 将陈述作为文书的一部分存档。 记录提取工具,帧和音频处理,即时投放,模范检查点,输出,再运行检查. 表述和实现的模型产出是必须复制的一部分。 这些检查应包括具体模式的投入惯例和处理限度。 对于在这里测量的推断运行,GPU成本差异小到足以在可行的路线中优先进行验证.

blocks.en: Validate more than one plausible representation. Use a human-coded subset to compare model–representation combinations that researchers could reasonably deploy, and use a substantively defined equivalence margin rather than treating non-significance as interchangeability.
blocks.zh: 验证不止一份可信的陈述。 使用人类编码的子集来比较模型 - 代表组合,研究者可以合理部署,并使用实质性定义的等值比值,而不是将非显式视为可互换性.

blocks.en: Match the candidate representations to the construct, then test utilization. The codebook indicates which channels could matter; a simple modality ablation shows whether the model actually uses them on the task.
blocks.zh: 将候选表述与构件匹配,然后测试利用率。 代码本显示哪些频道可能很重要;一个简单的模式衰减显示该模型是否在任务中实际使用它们.

blocks.en: Do not assume that additional modalities are integrated. Compare a combined route with its components. Check whether the combined input improves on the better component when the individual routes make different errors.
blocks.zh: 不假定其他模式是一体化的。 比较结合路线及其组件. 检查组合输入是否在单个路径发生不同错误时对更好的组件有所改进.

blocks.en: Validate the downstream quantity when automated labels feed substantive inference. Classification accuracy and estimand recovery need not select the same pipeline. Where possible, use the human-coded subset to quantify or correct the resulting measurement error.
blocks.zh: 在自动标签输入实质性推论时验证下游数量。 分类准确性和刺激性回收不需要选择同样的管道。 在可能的情况下,使用人码子集来量化或纠正由此产生的测量错误.

blocks.en: Archive the representation as part of the instrument. Record extraction tools, frame and audio handling, prompt placement, model checkpoints, outputs, and a re-run check. The representation and the realized model outputs are part of what must be reproducible.
blocks.zh: 将陈述作为文书的一部分存档。 记录提取工具,帧和音频处理,即时投放,模范检查点,输出,再运行检查. 表述和实现的模型产出是必须复制的一部分。

blocks.en: The evidence comes from three datasets and six open-weight models that fit on one A100 GPU. The primary application is German news, while HateMM and MUStARD are English; larger proprietary systems or future checkpoints may use modalities differently. The regression test is available only for the news data, although the prevalence analysis spans all three datasets. “Native video” is also not one perfectly standardized representation because each architecture implements its video pathway differently, and Qwen3-Omni required audio to be supplied separately. The main frame-based routes see at most the first 120 seconds and sixteen frames; more frames add little here, but faster-cut or much longer material may behave differently.
blocks.zh: 证据来自3个数据集和6个开放量级模型,它们适合一个A100GPU. 主要应用是德国新闻,而HateMM和MUSTARD为英语;更大的专有系统或未来的检查站可能使用不同的方式. 回归测试只针对新闻数据,尽管流行率分析跨越所有三个数据集. “原声录像”也不是完全标准化的表示,因为每个建筑采用不同的视频路径,而Qune3-Omni要求单独提供音频。 基于主帧的路由最多可看到前120秒和16帧;更多的帧在此增加很少,但更快剪切或更长的材料可能表现不同.

blocks.en: The validation samples also set boundaries on the claims. The news sample deliberately over-represents minority classes of four quota constructs, while HateMM and MUStARD are balanced samples. The prevalence analysis therefore concerns recovery of the human-coded prevalence in those samples, not population prevalence. Human labels are references rather than error-free ground truth. The news release is single-coded outside its published reliability pretest, and the hate and sarcasm datasets report imperfect inter-annotator agreement. Finally, comparisons across datasets confound the construct with language, genre, and annotation; we therefore treat the same-item contrasts as the strongest evidence for construct dependence.
blocks.zh: 鉴定样本还确定了索赔的界限。 新闻样本故意过多地代表了四个配额结构的少数阶层,而HateMM和MUSTARD则是平衡的样本. 因此,流行率分析涉及这些样本中人类编码的流行率的恢复,而不是人口流行率。 人类的标签是参考文献,而不是无错误的地面真理. 新闻发布在其公布的可靠性预测试之外是单码的,仇恨和讽刺的数据集报道了不完善的注释者间协议. 最后,各种数据集的比较将构造与语言、流派和注释混为一谈;因此,我们把同一项目对比视为构建依赖性的最有力证据。

blocks.en: Overall, across six open-weight models and three datasets, the choice of input representation changes video annotation quality, with effects that depend on the model and construct. Audio availability does not ensure that a model uses sound for the task, and combined text and video inputs rarely improve on the better individual route. Higher annotation accuracy does not reliably yield regression coefficients or sample prevalences closer to the human-coded estimates. Researchers using multimodal LLMs should validate the representation alongside the model and prompt, and assess the estimates they intend to derive from the labels.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在六个开放量级模型和三个数据集中,输入表示的选择会改变视频注释的质量,其效果取决于模型和构造. 音频的可用性无法确保一个模型在任务中使用声音,综合文本和视频投入很少在更好的单个路线上得到改善. 较高的注释精度并不能可靠地得出更接近人类编码估计数的回归系数或样本流行率. 使用多式联运有限责任公司的研究者应当与模型一起验证其表述,并迅速评估他们打算从标签中得出的估计数。

blocks.en: 6 News sample
blocks.zh: 6个 新闻样本

blocks.en: We draw the news test sample from the published release (version 2.0.0; 8,623 coded videos, of which the original coders classify 7,978 as news), using a class-quota sampler with seed 42. We target 200 videos per class of geographic scope (three classes), negative news, conflict, and scope. For each variable, we exclude videos with unclear codes from its sampling pools. At each step, the sampler selects the class furthest below its target, draws a candidate with probability proportional to its country’s share of the news corpus, and counts that video toward every matching class still below target. We exclude 132 development videos that we drew earlier with the same sampler and smaller targets.
blocks.zh: 我们从公布的版本(第2.0版;8,623段编码视频,其中原始编码者将7,978段归类为新闻)中抽取新闻测试样本,使用带有42种种子的类配额样本. 我们的目标是每类地理范围(三类)、负面新闻、冲突和范围200个视频。 对于每个变量,我们从取样池中排除了代码不明的视频。 在每一步,采样者选择最低于目标等级的选手,抽取一个与其国家新闻机构份额成比例的概率候选人,并将该视频数到仍然低于目标的每个匹配等级。 我们排除了我们早些时候用同样的取样器和较小的目标绘制的132个发展视频。

blocks.en: The sampler selects 612 test videos. We could not download nine because of age restrictions, blocked access, or failed writes, and we did not replace them, leaving 603. We reproduce the 612 selected videos exactly when we re-run the sampler with the archived settings. Because each video counts toward every matching class, the quotas over-represent minority classes rather than producing exact balance (Table 6 ). The sample’s country mix (Switzerland 58%, Austria 34%, Germany 8%) also differs from the news corpus (47%, 38%, 16%). We use 599 videos in the regression analysis, excluding three without view counts and one with an unclear human code for geographic scope.
