blocks.en: The frozen local plan specified the original text, frames + audio, combined, description, metadata, and human-transcript comparisons and identified the ablations, engagement regression, and re-run as exploratory. The switch to vLLM on the A100 and the additions of Qwen3-Omni, Qwen2.5-Omni, and MiniCPM-o followed inspection of interim laptop results; all reported primary predictions were generated anew on the A100. Native and full video, the HateMM target variables, the expanded audio diagnostics, and the integrated grid and downstream comparisons were subsequent extensions. The archived plan and deviation log document the original scope and these changes; they do not constitute a public preregistration of the final design.
blocks.zh: 被冻结的本地计划指定了原始文本,帧+音频,组合,描述,元数据,以及人文语录比较,并认定了活化,接触回归,重运行为探索性. A100号机上切换到vLLM,并在A100号机上添加了Qune3-Omni号,Qune2.5-Omni号和MiniCPM-o号机,随后检查了临时笔记本电脑结果;所有报告的初级预测均在A100号机上重新生成. 原生和完整的视频、HateMM的目标变量、扩大的音频诊断以及综合网格和下游的比较都是后来的扩展。 存档的计划和偏离日志记录了原始范围和这些变化;它们不构成最终设计的公开预登记。

blocks.en: Inference and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 推论和预处理

blocks.en: We use greedy decoding (temperature 0) for coding calls, with at most 120 output tokens and a JSON-schema grammar that lists each construct’s legal integer codes. We disable reasoning modes through the chat template. For description calls in the describe-first route, we use greedy decoding with at most 450 tokens. We process requests in batches of 256 and disable prefix caching. We also disable the multimodal preprocessing cache except for capped full-video runs. We run Nemotron-3 Nano Omni with one image tile per frame.
blocks.zh: 我们使用贪婪的解码(温度0)进行编码呼叫,最多120个输出符号和一个JSON-schema语法列出每个构造的法律整数代码. 我们通过聊天模板禁用推理模式 。 对于描述-第一路线的呼叫, 我们使用贪婪的解码 最多450个符号。 我们分批处理256个请求,并禁用前缀缓存。 我们还禁用多式联运预处理缓存,但封装的全视频运行除外。 我们运行Nemotron -3 Nano Omni 每帧一个图像瓦片。

blocks.en: We divide audio longer than 30 seconds into consecutive 30-second clips (at most four), matching the per-clip limit of the Gemma 4 audio encoder ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . We transcribe speech with Whisper large-v3-turbo ( Radford et al., 2023 ) and automatic language detection. We extract on-screen text with Apple’s Vision framework at one frame per second and remove near-duplicate lines. In the text prompts, we retain at most 6,000 characters of the automatic transcript, 3,000 characters of OCR text, and 6,000 characters of a generated description. For frames + audio, we sample the midpoints of sixteen equal segments of the first 120 seconds and scale the images to 448 pixels on the longest side.
blocks.zh: 我们把超过30秒的音频分为连续30秒的剪辑(最多4个),匹配Gemma 4音频编码器的每剪辑限制(Google DeepMind,2026年). 我们用Whisper大V3-turbo(Radford等人,2023年)和自动语言检测来翻译语音。 我们用苹果的视野框架从屏幕上提取每秒一个帧,并去掉几近重复的线条。 在文字提示中,我们保留了最多6000个自动笔录字符,3000个OCR文字字符,以及6000个生成的描述字符. 对于帧+音频,我们对前120秒十六等段的中点进行取样,并将图像缩放到最长边的448像素.

blocks.en: For native video, we prepare a file containing the first 120 seconds at the same resolution and let each model’s video loader sample sixteen frames. We supply audio as separate clips to Gemma 4, Qwen3-Omni, and MiniCPM-o; a vLLM error prevents Qwen3-Omni from using time-aligned audio. For Qwen2.5-Omni and Nemotron, we supply audio aligned with the video. For full video, we pass the original file and use each model’s default sampling. We provide its audio as separate clips from the first 120 seconds for Gemma 4, Qwen3-Omni, and MiniCPM-o, and as time-aligned audio for Qwen2.5-Omni and Nemotron. We count processing failures as incorrect and omit full-video cells where failures exceed 5%. All retained full-video cells use the original file. For capped runs, we use the same file, limit the video loader to 32 frames, and supply audio clips from the first 120 seconds. Capped-news tests cover 20 videos per Qwen model; capped HateMM tests cover all 400 videos for every model (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 对于本地的视频,我们准备一个文件,包含同一分辨率的前120秒,让每个模型的视频加载器抽样16帧. 我们向Gemma 4, Quen3- Omni和MiniCPM-o分别提供音频;一个vLLM错误使Quen3-Omni无法使用时间同步音频. 对于Quen2.5-Omni和Nemotron, 我们提供与视频一致的音频。 我们通过原始文件, 我们从头120秒开始提供Gemma 4、Quen3-Omni和MiniCPM-o的音频,以及Quen2.5-Omni和Nemotron的时序音频。 我们把处理失败算作不正确, 并省略了全视频单元格, 其中失败率超过5%。 所有保留的全部视频单元格都使用原始文件. 对于封装的运行,我们使用相同的文件,将视频加载器限制在32帧之内,并且从头120秒提供音频剪辑. Capped-news测试涵盖每个Quen模型的20个视频;Capped HateMM测试涵盖每个模型的所有400个视频(表10).

blocks.en: In the Gemma diagnostic tests, we add an audio-only route, follow the recommended media placement (frames before the instruction, audio after it), ask directly about music, and test transcription with the developer’s prompt. We also repeat the tests with the Hugging Face transformers version installed in the vLLM image. We summarize the runtime configuration in Table 7 . We did not log the PyTorch and transformers versions separately; we used the versions shipped with the public image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0 .

blocks.en: You are a trained content analyst coding a German-language news video posted on TikTok by a news outlet, following a published content-analysis codebook. You receive the metadata, an automatic speech transcript of the audio track, and the on-screen text extracted by optical character recognition (OCR). You do not see the video. === CODEBOOK === V6 Visual set-up. How is the video visually set up? 1 = Journalist-centric: A journalist/moderator is nearly constantly visible and in the foreground. 2 = Live-footage with journalistic elements: One or multiple shot(s) of live-footage including journalistic elements, such as a journalist or someone interviewing people. 3 = Live-footage without journalistic elements: One or multiple shot(s) of live-footage from an event without a journalist visually present anywhere in the video. V8b Other peoples’ voice (overlap and/or in-situ). Is the voice of people other than the journalist/moderator used in the video? 1 = used, 0 = not used. (Ignore the outlet endcard.) V8d Music. Is music used in the video? 1 = used, 0 = not used. (Ignore the outlet endcard.) V9b Call-to-interact on TikTok: visual- or audio-based prompts to the audience to interact with the video or outlet on TikTok. This can include prompts to like, share, comment, discuss, and/or share their thoughts on the topic in the video, e.g., "What do you think about this?" or "Please share this video". Interactions with the outlet refer to subscribing to the channel, following or clicking on their profile, that can also be purely visual or via an animation (clicking on the subscribe button). 1 = present, 0 = not present. V9c Call-to-interact outside of TikTok: visual- or audio-based prompts to the audience to interact with the video or outlet that would result in the audience leaving TikTok. For example by prompting the audience to go to the news outlet’s website ("Klicke auf diesen Link, um mehr zu erfahren") or to another platform ("Schau’ mal auf unseren YouTube-Kanal nach"). 1 = present, 0 = not present. V12 Geographic scope. Compare the topic/location of the event of the video with the channel’s nationality (given in the material). Indications of the geographic scope of the video can be explicit, i.e., mentioning a concrete location, or implicit, such as discussing the findings of a representative study from a national research institute. Does the video deal with domestic or foreign news? 0 = There is no concrete geographical scope to the topic, e.g., the video deals with a disease and doesn’t mention explicitly any specific location. 1 = The video deals with domestic news, e.g., srfnews (Swiss) shows footage from the rail accident in the Gotthard Base Tunnel (in Switzerland) or zeitimbild (Austrian) is interviewing Austrian politicians to be elected in the European Election. 2 = The video deals with foreign news, e.g., a video from zeitimbild (Austrian) that deals with the process against Trump in the US or a video of tagesschau (German) dealing with an earthquake in Mexico and interviewing German tourists in Mexico. V15 Negative news. Stories with overall particularly negative topics such as death, injury, defeat and loss (of a job, for example). They can be of economic, political, physical, psychological or social nature. Guiding question: Does the story deal with bad news? Important: code the topic, not the tonality. 1 = yes, 0 = no. V16 Conflict. Stories concerning conflict such as controversies, arguments, splits, strikes, fights, insurrections, and warfare. Is the focus of the story on the conflict? 0 = No, e.g., the video focusses on the fact that demonstrators vandalized buildings on their march through a city center (what’s the conflict?); report on the court decision on Sebastian Kurz (not reported as conflict, but as decision); Italy will introduce smartphone-ban at schools (not reported as conflict, but as decision). 1 = Yes, e.g., two opposing positions or opinions are mentioned about an event or a decision; or a news outlet reports on Parisians demonstrating against the Olympic Games; reflection on measurements taken during COVID in interview - including stating the opposing position. V17 Scope. Stories that describe how many people are directly involved or potentially impacted by the reported event. This includes both literal numbers mentioned with a verifiable source, e.g., "thousands of people", or a single person, as well as figurative speeches of a group of people, such as "all Netflix-viewers", "Every woman living in Germany" or "Germany". 1 = yes, 0 = no. General rule: If the video summarizes multiple events, code the variables based on the clear, first story in the video, excluding the introduction teaser. === MATERIAL === Outlet: srfnews (nationality of the channel: Switzerland) Caption: <caption> Hashtags: <hashtags> Automatic speech transcript: <automatic transcript> On-screen text (OCR): <on-screen text> Code every variable strictly according to the codebook. Answer with one JSON object with the keys "V6", "V8b", "V8d", "V9b", "V9c", "V12", "V15", "V16", "V17" and integer codes only.
blocks.zh: 你是一个训练有素的内容分析师 在TikTok上发布一则德文新闻视频 由一个新闻发布站, 接收元数据,音频音轨的自动语音记录,和通过光学字符识别(OCR)提取的屏幕文本. 你没有看到视频。 === CODEBOOK === V6视觉设置. 视频是如何视觉设置的? 1=以记者为中心: 记者/主持人几乎经常在眼前出现。 2 = 有记者元素的活脚: 一次或多次拍摄活脚,包括记者,如记者或采访人员。 3=无记者内容的活脚: 一次或多次现场拍摄, 五. 8 b 其他民族的声音(重叠和/或就地发言)。 除了记者/主持人之外, 1=使用,0=未使用. V9b Call-to-interact on TikTok:基于视觉或音频的提示让观众与TikTok上的视频或输出互动. 这可以包括提示在视频中喜欢,分享,评论,讨论和/或分享他们对这个话题的想法,如"你对此有什么看法?"或"请分享这段视频". 与输出的交互是指在频道上签名,跟随或点击其配置,也可以是纯视觉的或通过动画(点击订阅按钮). 1=在场,0=未在场. V9c Call-to-interact outside of TikTok:基于视觉或音频的提示给观众与视频或输出进行互动,从而导致观众离开TikTok. 例如, 促使观众前往新闻网站(Klicke auf diesen Link, um mehr zu erfahren)或另一平台(Schau ' mal auf unseren YouTube-Kanal nach)。 1=在场,0=未在场. V12 地理范围. 将视频事件的主题/位置与频道的国籍(在材料中提供)进行比较. 视频的地理范围可以明确,即提到具体地点,或暗示,例如讨论国家研究机构的代表性研究的结果。 影片是处理国内新闻还是外国新闻?. 0 = 主题没有具体的地域范围,例如,视频涉及疾病,没有明确提及任何具体地点。 1=该视频涉及国内新闻,如srfnews(瑞士)显示哥特哈德基地隧道(瑞士境内)或zeitimbild(奥地利境内)铁路事故的镜头正在采访即将入选欧洲大选的奥地利政治家. 2=该视频涉及外国新闻,例如来自zeitimbild(奥地利语)的视频,该视频涉及美国反对特朗普的进程,或Tagesschau(德语)处理墨西哥地震并采访墨西哥的德国游客的视频. 第十五届 负面新闻. 涉及死亡、受伤、战败和损失(例如,工作)等总的负面话题的故事。 它们可以是经济、政治、身体、心理或社会性质的。 指导性问题: 故事是关于坏消息吗? 重要的: 编码主题,而不是属性. 1=是,0=无 V16冲突. 有关冲突的故事,例如争论、争论、分裂、罢工、战斗、叛乱和战争。 故事的焦点是冲突吗? 0 = 否, 例如影片关注示威者在穿过市中心游行时破坏建筑物的事实(冲突是什么? ); 报告法院对塞巴斯蒂安·库尔兹的裁决(没有报告为冲突,而是决定); 意大利将在学校引入智能手机禁用(没有报告为冲突,而是决定). 1=是,例如,提到两个对立立场或对一个事件或决定的意见;或报道巴黎人示威反对奥运会;反思COVID采访期间采取的衡量措施,包括说明对立立场。 V17 范围。 描述有多少人直接卷入或可能受到所报道事件影响的故事。 这既包括有可核查来源的提及字面数字,如"千人",或单人,也包括一群人的比喻性发言,如"所有Netflix-viewers","每个生活在德国的女人"或"德国". 1=是,0=没有。 如果视频总结了多个事件,则根据视频中清晰的,第一个故事来编码变量,不包括介绍取笑者. === 材料 出道:srfnews(频道国籍:瑞士). 说明: "Caption" hashtags: "hashtags" (中文(简体) ). 自动语音记录:<自动记录> 屏幕文本(OCR):<屏幕文本> 严格按照代码簿编码每个变量. 用一个 JSON 对象回答,只有"V6","V8b","V8d","V9b","V9c","V12","V15","V16","V17"和整数代码.

VISUALS: setting, people, and type of footage (e.g., presenter to camera, live footage, graphics or maps, screenshots, stickers or emojis). SOUND: music, sound effects, ambient noise, tone of voice.
